top_signals.title: Green notice 2026/02
top_signals.summary: Green notices cover significant and/or significant proposals for Bank of England reporting. If any of these proposals are finalised and are to be implemented, they will appear in a statistical notice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump calls for Bombardier boycott as Canada hits US with tariffs
top_signals.summary: President’s post on social media comes hours before Ottawa’s retaliatory trade measures against Washington
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
top_signals.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Capital B adds 376 Bitcoin in $29M purchase, boosting holdings to 3,521 BTC
top_signals.summary: Capital B’s latest Bitcoin purchase was its largest in nearly a year, pushing the French company ahead of H100 Group among publicly traded BTC holders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
